title: Glass Cathedral Cycle
description: Four views of the same translucent green-glass gothic cathedral across four lighting and weather conditions.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the glass cathedral as a single uninterrupted green bottle-glass slab carved into gothic form. 02-04 preserve the exact building silhouette and camera position while changing interior light, weather, and surrounding plaza.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-04. Queue may run 02-04 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
